format: Markdown with embedded TypeScript Vue component script
description: This file defines a Vue component that implements a simple notes management interface. It includes functionality for feature flagging via environment variables, local storage persistence of notes, and UI elements for creating and deleting notes.

methods.name: getFeatureFlags
methods.description: Reads optional feature flags from VITE_FEATURE_FLAGS environment variable, parses JSON if possible, and returns a record of flags.

methods.name: useNotesStorage
methods.description: Manages notes state synchronized with localStorage, providing functions to add and delete notes.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Validates input and adds a new note to the notes list, or shows validation errors.
